scope: New A/B/C analyses; do not rerun CPU feasibility, representation review curves, cost analysis or severity classification
suitability_priority: verified anomaly-label provenance and detection unit
complete labelled train/validation/test units without overlap and both evaluation classes
original-ID aligned actual parser assignments plus GT
observed errors visible to the selected representation
temporal novelty and attainable coverage; resource cost
suitability_gate: No dataset is ready for parser-recovery training without the first three criteria. Grouping/text headroom is a necessary representation opportunity, never a downstream performance guarantee. No detector outcomes used to rank candidates.
candidate_scope: All 13 existing stream systems and primary-source label documentation; HDFS_v2/v3 noted as distinct unsupported variants
B: Fixed operational groups: optimal one-output-string per group equals majority GT; exact residual N-sum_g max_t n_gt. Coalescing corrected strings may merge pure splits; cannot split mixed groups. GT membership repair is a separate oracle.

C.population: Previously verified saved disjoint@100 score vectors, strict FAIL majority samples5-9; seeds0-4
C.local_calibration: Partition original untouched-test templates using SHA256(model,system,seed,template) first64bits modulo2; half calibrate, half evaluate; no template overlap. No base model refits.
C.mapping: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1, class_weight=None), separate calibrator per method/model/system/seed, minimum10 calibration rows and2 examples each class; no test tuning
C.ECE: 10 equal-width bins; FAIL=positive; 5 and15 bins sensitivity
C.frequency: Ground-truth template occurrences in original capped500 suite:1,2-5,6+; descriptor only, not predictor feature
C.cross_system: Raw D-zero gives source-trained target evaluation. Calibration transfer for label-independent baselines and local-only Clotho from HDFS/Spark/Linux calibrate templates to held-out systems evaluation templates. Do not claim clean U/D calibration-map transfer: saved source-system models can have trained on held-out target labels.
C.statistics: Per-system five-seed means; system-cluster bootstrap of paired Brier differences; never line-IID tests; report calibration label cost and eligible cohort
